newsitem.title: PERU: Peru's February trade gap falls 21.5 pct - customs. [CORRECTED 21:20 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Peru's February trade gap falls 21.5 pct - customs. [CORRECTED 21:20 GMT]

text.p: (Corrects percentage drop in headline and first paragraph to 21.5 percent from 17.8 percent)
Peru's February trade deficit fell 21.5 percent to $65.05 million compared with the same month last year, according to Customs Service figures released Wednesday.
Customs said exports rose to $480.88 million in February from $457.56 million in the same month of 1996, while imports were up to $545.93 million from $540.43 million.
The trade deficit for the first two months of 1997 was down 24.9 percent to $213.54 million.
The Customs figures do not include all statistics used to calculate the Central Reserve Bank's official trade balance figures, which are published later.
